name: Red Snake 3D
author: Addicting Games
description: Red Snake 3D is a free avoider game. The Red Snake is in a race and the red Snake intends to win. Dodge barricades and walls as you slither through an ice white world of gleaming indifference. Control the red snake and slink through challenging levels at top speed. You need to become unburdened as you move towards the finish line in each level because even though you'll be focused on staying alive the whole time your ultimate end goal is to make it to the finish line. This is a fast-paced game of slithering, sneaking, slipping and sliding your way through icebergs and other obstacles. It is a game of reflexes, a game of will, a game of determination, and ultimately a fun, free racing game. Try it and you're sure to enjoy it. In Red Snake, you might be the snake and the venom might be real but ultimately if you want to make it to the top of the leaderboard you're gonna have to bring your own bite. So, bear those fangs and get those ribs moving in this fun, fast, and furious racing game.
